## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** Dual-account ($2K Safe-2 + ~$1.65K Bold-2) per risk-rules.md. Position sizing varies by setup; baseline uses default engine qty. BS-synthetic pricing does not reflect real-fills slippage.
2. **Sample bias:** 6 J anchor days (3 winners, 3 losers) + 6 quarters OOS (2025-Q1 to 2026-Q2). Overfit risk: baseline only, no parameter changes tested.
3. **Out-of-sample:** Quarterly PNL provided (see below). No explicit IS/OOS split in this run; full-period wide_pnl = -$1464.23 (225 trades, WR=18.7%).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS -- BS-synthetic pricing used, not real OPRA fills.
5. **Failure modes:** Baseline loses on first two winner days, skips 5/05/5/06 losers, wins on 5/07 loser days. Negative wide_pnl due to losses in 2025-Q1, Q3, Q4, 2026-Q2 offset by gains in 2025-Q2, 2026-Q1.
6. **Concentration:** top5_pct=999.0 (invalid due to negative total PNL). Winning quarters: 2025-Q2 ($769.79) + 2026-Q1 ($1548.89) = $2318.68; losing quarters sum to -$3782.91.
